summary: Round 1 had no findings, so none to re-verify. The round-2 judge fix (commit 41eb616) only touches tests/engine/hand-evaluator.perf.test.ts: it wraps the evaluate and buildEvaluatorTables timings in a fixed 10-iteration loop (RUNS=10 constant), keeps the minimum of each, and checks the checksum on each run. It adds no new untrusted input. The existing env-derived thresholds (EVALUATOR_MIN_EVALS_PER_SEC, EVALUATOR_MAX_BUILD_MS) are unchanged and feed only test assertions. It adds no file, shell, or network operations, no dependencies, and no secrets. The loop bound is a constant, so it cannot be used to exhaust resources. No production code changed. .claude/settings.json is out of scope. No findings.
